sentences.arabic: أَيْنَ بَيْتُكَ، وَمَنْ يَسْكُنُ فِيهِ؟
sentences.transliteration: ayna baytuka, wa man yaskunu feehi?

sentences.arabic: مَا هَذَا، وَمَا ذَلِكَ؟
sentences.transliteration: maa haadhaa, wa maa dhaalika?

sentences.arabic: كَمْ وَلَدًا عِنْدَهُمْ؟
sentences.transliteration: kam waladan 3indahum?

sentences.arabic: نَحْنُ هُنَا، لَكِنَّهُ لَيْسَ هُنَاكَ
sentences.transliteration: na7nu hunaa, laakinnahu laysa hunaak

sentences.arabic: لِمَاذَا خَرَجَتْ هِيَ مِنَ الْبَيْتِ مُبَكِّرًا هَكَذَا؟
sentences.transliteration: limaadhaa kharajat hiya mina al-bayti mubakkiran haakadhaa?

sentences.arabic: مِنْ أَيْنَ أَنْتَ، وَمَتَى وَصَلْتَ؟
sentences.transliteration: min ayna anta, wa mataa wasalta?

sentences.arabic: ضَعِ الْمَفَاتِيحَ تَحْتَ الطَّاوِلَةِ، مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
sentences.transliteration: da3i al-mafaateeha ta7ta at-taawilati, min fadlik

sentences.arabic: الْحَقِيبَةُ بِجَانِبِ الْبَابِ، خَلْفَ الْكُرْسِيِّ
sentences.transliteration: al-7aqeebatu bijaanibi al-baabi, khalfa al-kursiyy

sentences.arabic: أَشْرَبُ الشَّايَ مَعَ الْحَلِيبِ، لَكِنْ بِدُونِ سُكَّرٍ
sentences.transliteration: ashrabu ash-shaaya ma3a al-7aleebi, laakin bidooni sukkar

sentences.arabic: بَقِينَا عِنْدَنَا فِي الْبَيْتِ حَتَّى الْمَسَاءِ لِأَنَّ الْمَطَرَ كَانَ يَنْزِلُ
sentences.transliteration: baqeenaa 3indanaa fee al-bayti 7attaa al-masaa2i li2anna al-matara kaana yanzil

sentences.arabic: اِغْسِلْ يَدَيْكَ قَبْلَ الْأَكْلِ وَبَعْدَهُ
sentences.transliteration: ighsil yadayka qabla al-akli wa ba3dah

sentences.arabic: الْمَحَلُّ مُقَابِلَ الْمَسْجِدِ، بَيْنَ الْبَنْكِ وَالْمَدْرَسَةِ
sentences.transliteration: al-ma7allu muqaabila al-masjidi, bayna al-banki wal-madrasa

sentences.arabic: أَسْتَيْقِظُ دَائِمًا مُبَكِّرًا، لَكِنِّي أَتَأَخَّرُ أَحْيَانًا
sentences.transliteration: astayqizu daa2iman mubakkiran, laakinnee ata2akhkharu a7yaanaa

sentences.arabic: أَبِي لَا يَشْرَبُ الْقَهْوَةَ فِي اللَّيْلِ أَبَدًا
sentences.transliteration: abee laa yashrabu al-qahwata fee al-layli abadaa

sentences.arabic: كُلْ أَكْثَرَ قَلِيلًا مِنْ فَضْلِكَ، فَالطَّعَامُ كَافٍ
sentences.transliteration: kul akthara qaleelan min fadlika, fat-ta3aamu kaafin

sentences.arabic: هَلْ مَا زَالَ فِي الْعَمَلِ، أَمْ خَرَجَ بِالْفِعْلِ؟
sentences.transliteration: hal maa zaala fee al-3amali, am kharaja bil-fi3l?

sentences.arabic: نَزُورُ جَدَّتَنَا مَرَّةً فِي الْأُسْبُوعِ، عَادَةً يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ
sentences.transliteration: nazooru jaddatanaa marratan fee al-usboo3i, 3aadatan yawma al-jumu3a

sentences.arabic: جَاءَ الْجَمِيعُ تَقْرِيبًا، وَكَانَ الْبَيْتُ مُمْتَلِئًا بِالْكَامِلِ
sentences.transliteration: jaa2a al-jamee3u taqreeban, wa kaana al-baytu mumtali2an bil-kaamil

sentences.arabic: عُمْرُ ابْنِي اثْنَا عَشَرَ عَامًا
sentences.transliteration: 3umru ibnee ithnaa 3ashara 3aamaa

sentences.arabic: فِي فَصْلِنَا خَمْسَةَ عَشَرَ طَالِبًا
sentences.transliteration: fee faslinaa khamsata 3ashara taalibaa

sentences.arabic: شَقَّتُنَا فِي الطَّابِقِ الثَّالِثِ
sentences.transliteration: shaqqatunaa fee at-taabiqi ath-thaalith

sentences.arabic: جَاءَ أَكْثَرُ مِنْ أَلْفِ شَخْصٍ إِلَى الْعُرْسِ
sentences.transliteration: jaa2a aktharu min alfi shakhsin ilaa al-3urs

sentences.arabic: عُدَّ إِلَى عِشْرِينَ، ثُمَّ افْتَحْ عَيْنَيْكَ
sentences.transliteration: 3udda ilaa 3ishreena, thumma ifta7 3aynayk

sentences.arabic: جَاءَ هُوَ الْأَوَّلَ فِي السِّبَاقِ، وَجِئْتُ أَنَا الْآخِرَ
sentences.transliteration: jaa2a huwa al-awwala fee as-sibaaqi, wa ji2tu anaa al-aakhir

sentences.arabic: أَعْطِنِي كِيلُوَيْنِ مِنَ الطَّمَاطِمِ، مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
sentences.transliteration: a3tinee keeloowayni mina at-tamaatimi, min fadlik

sentences.arabic: خُذْ مَعَكَ زُجَاجَةَ مَاءٍ
sentences.transliteration: khudh ma3aka zujaajata maa2

sentences.arabic: وُضِعَ السُّكَّرُ فِي هَذَا الشَّايِ بِإِفْرَاطٍ
sentences.transliteration: wudi3a as-sukkaru fee haadhaa ash-shaayi bi-ifraat

sentences.arabic: أَخَوَايَ كِلَاهُمَا يَسْكُنَانِ بَعِيدًا
sentences.transliteration: akhawaaya kilaahumaa yaskunaani ba3eedaa

sentences.arabic: أَخَذَ كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ مِنَ الْأَطْفَالِ قِطْعَةً وَاحِدَةً مِنَ الْكَعْكِ
sentences.transliteration: akhadha kullu waa7idin mina al-atfaali qit3atan waa7idatan mina al-ka3k

sentences.arabic: طُولُ الْغُرْفَةِ أَرْبَعَةُ أَمْتَارٍ، وَعَرْضُهَا ثَلَاثَةٌ
sentences.transliteration: toolu al-ghurfati arba3atu amtaarin, wa 3arduhaa thalaatha

sentences.arabic: يَبْدَأُ رَمَضَانُ فِي مَارِسَ هَذَا الْعَامَ
sentences.transliteration: yabda2u ramadaanu fee maarisa haadhaa al-3aam

sentences.arabic: تَارِيخُ مِيلَادِي الْعَاشِرُ مِنْ مَايُو
sentences.transliteration: taareekhu meelaadee al-3aashiru min maayoo

sentences.arabic: تَبْدَأُ الْمَدْرَسَةُ فِي سِبْتَمْبَرَ كُلَّ سَنَةٍ
sentences.transliteration: tabda2u al-madrasatu fee sibtambara kulla sana

sentences.arabic: الْحَجُّ فِي شَهْرِ ذِي الْحِجَّةِ
sentences.transliteration: al-7ajju fee shahri dhil-7ijja

sentences.arabic: سَنُسَافِرُ الشَّهْرَ الْقَادِمَ، فِي يُولْيُو
sentences.transliteration: sanusaafiru ash-shahra al-qaadima, fee yoolyoo

sentences.arabic: هَلْ تَسْتَخْدِمُ التَّقْوِيمَ الْهِجْرِيَّ أَمِ الْمِيلَادِيَّ؟
sentences.transliteration: hal tastakhdimu at-taqweema al-hijriyya ami al-meelaadiyy?
